title: 200% SMI is the rule. The euro conversion is not.
summary: Ley 14/2013 art. 62.3.f requires sufficient resources. The joint instruction of the Ministries of Inclusion and Foreign Affairs fixes the amount as 200% of SMI per month for the holder, 75% of SMI for the first family member, and 25% of SMI for each additional member. RD 126/2026 publishes SMI as 1,221 €/month (14 payments) and an annual comparison floor of 17,094 €. The instruction does not say whether ‘mensualmente el 200% del SMI’ uses the gazette monthly figure or the annual figure divided by twelve. This codex therefore publishes the legal formula only, and shows both arithmetic illustrations as illustrations — never as the statute.

sources.label: Legal formula (settled)
sources.quote: Titulares: cantidad que represente mensualmente el 200 % del salario mínimo interprofesional (SMI). Unidades familiares de dos personas: al menos el 75 % del SMI; 25 % del SMI por cada miembro adicional.

sources.label: Gazette SMI annual floor
sources.quote: Art. 3.1 RD 126/2026: cuantía anual de comparación no inferior a 17.094 €.

guideMust: Show a conflict banner. Do not pick 2×1,221 or 2×(17,094/12) as the legal amount.

title: Some consular pages add local filing rules that are not national eligibility law
summary: The national file is Ley 14/2013 arts. 74 bis–quater plus the joint instruction. Individual consulates publish extra local conditions (for example a pre-visa NIE, a cash fee in local currency, or a longer passport validity). Those pages are official for that post’s filing window. They are not a national amendment of arts. 74 bis–quater. This codex does not treat them as settled Spanish eligibility law.

sources.label: National instruction (document list)
sources.quote: Instrucción octava lists the national document set for the visa or authorisation.

sources.label: Example of local addenda (Istanbul, 7 Jan 2025)
sources.quote: That post has required an NIE before the visa filing and a USD cash fee. That is a local filing rule of the post, not Ley 14/2013.

guideMust: Banner on consular-route pages. Direct the reader to the competent consulate’s current page for local filing mechanics, without restating stale euro figures from old consular PDFs.
